focus: D2 security - spec-kit hooks and trust boundaries

findingDetails.title: The completion-evidence sentinel source contains a raw NUL byte, making the file binary to search and diff tooling
findingDetails.evidence: Byte 16206 of the release-introduced file is a raw 0x00 inside the dedup hash-seed template literal where the escape input was intended. rg answers 'binary file matches (found \"\\0\" byte around offset 16206)' instead of lines; diff prints 'Binary files ... differ'; file classifies the file as data. Git still renders it as text because the byte is past the 8000-byte sniff window. The same defect pre-exists at .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/deep-improvement/scripts/shared/rubric-guard.cjs:59 (raw NUL in h.update(r.body + separator)), present at v4.0.0.2. The sweep of the four focus trees found no other instance.
findingDetails.recommendation: Write the separator as the escape sequence in both files so the source stays ASCII; the runtime hash input is unchanged.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Scanned every source-like file under the four focus trees for NUL bytes (two hits), read both sites in place, confirmed rg/diff/file behavior, and confirmed the sentinel's NUL arrived with its first in-range commit.
